name: Toolbar
summary: A single tab stop holding a row (or column) of related commands: buttons, toggle buttons, radio buttons, groups and dividers. Choose it over loose buttons when several commands act on the same object and should be reached with arrow keys; the items are Button and ToggleButton, so build those first.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Sets the toolbar's padding and, through context, its items' size.

inputs.name: vertical
inputs.description: Stacks items in a column as wide as its widest item; drops the size padding.

inputs.name: checkedValues
inputs.description: Controlled checked state: a map from each toggle or radio name to the list of its checked values.

inputs.name: onCheckedValueChange
inputs.description: Runs with {name, checkedItems} when a toggle or radio item changes, from a click or key.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: ToolbarButton, ToolbarToggleButton, ToolbarRadioButton (inside a ToolbarRadioGroup), ToolbarGroup and ToolbarDivider children.

inputs.name: itemAppearance
inputs.description: Each button, toggle and radio item's own appearance prop: only primary, subtle and transparent are offered.

inputs.name: itemVertical
inputs.description: ToolbarButton's vertical prop: stacks its icon above its label with a 24px icon.

inputs.name: itemNameValue
inputs.description: ToolbarToggleButton and ToolbarRadioButton require a name and a value; the checked map is keyed by name and lists values.

inputs.name: itemDisabled
inputs.description: Each item's disabled and disabledFocusable, as on Button.

anatomy.name: Toolbar
anatomy.description: A flex row of items centred on the cross axis, padded by size; a column when vertical.

anatomy.name: ToolbarButton
anatomy.description: A Button (see button.json) limited to primary, subtle and transparent, optionally with icon stacked over label.

anatomy.name: ToolbarToggleButton
anatomy.description: A ToggleButton whose checked look is the subtle selected fill, whatever its appearance.

anatomy.name: ToolbarRadioButton
anatomy.description: A ToggleButton in a ToolbarRadioGroup: one checked per name, same checked look as the toggle.

anatomy.name: ToolbarRadioGroup
anatomy.description: An unstyled container that makes its ToolbarRadioButtons one exclusive set.

anatomy.name: ToolbarGroup
anatomy.description: A flex container of items, centred on the cross axis; a fit-content column in a vertical toolbar. Used to push a set of items to the far end.

anatomy.name: ToolbarDivider
anatomy.description: A Divider (see the divider component) as a 1px line in a 24px-wide slot between items.

variants.description: A row; dividers are vertical lines.
A column as wide as its content, with no size padding; groups stack their items; dividers are horizontal lines.

layout.text: The toolbar is a flex row centring items on the cross axis; horizontal padding by size is 0 by 4px (small), 4px by 8px (medium) and 4px by 20px (large), with no gap between items: buttons sit edge to edge.
A vertical toolbar is a fit-content column; the size padding is not applied, so the base 4px by 8px padding remains at every size.
A group is a flex container centring its items; in a vertical toolbar it becomes a fit-content column.

A divider between horizontal items is an inline-flex vertical Divider capped at 1px width with 12px padding each side, at least 20px tall, its line strokeWidthThin in colorNeutralStroke2; in a vertical toolbar it is a horizontal Divider with the width cap lifted.
A vertical ToolbarButton stacks its icon above its label (flex column) and sets the icon to 24px with no margin.

states.text: Items rest in their Button appearance; the toolbar itself has no background, border or shadow.

Items hover as Button of their appearance: a subtle item takes colorSubtleBackgroundHover and colorNeutralForeground2Hover. A checked toggle or radio hovers with its ToggleButton appearance's hover tokens, since the toolbar overrides only the rest look.
Items press as Button of their appearance: subtle reads colorSubtleBackgroundPressed and colorNeutralForeground2Pressed.

A checked ToolbarToggleButton or ToolbarRadioButton takes colorSubtleBackgroundSelected with colorNeutralForeground2Selected text and a colorNeutralForeground2BrandSelected icon, shown filled, whatever its appearance.
Items draw Button's inset indicator on keyboard focus: the border turns colorStrokeFocus2 with a 1px colorStrokeFocus2 ring inside; the toolbar itself draws no focus indicator.
Disabled items take Button's disabled look; the toolbar has no disabled state of its own.

behaviour.text: The toolbar is one tab stop: Tab enters it on one item and leaves it; arrow keys move between items along its orientation.
Activating a ToolbarToggleButton flips its value in the checked list under its name and calls onCheckedValueChange with the name and the new checked values.
Activating a ToolbarRadioButton makes its value the only checked value under its name and calls onCheckedValueChange.
The toolbar's size and orientation reach every item through context; items size themselves to match rather than taking their own size prop.
Item colours transition as Button's do: background, border and color over durationFaster with curveEasyEase; the toolbar adds no motion.

keyboard: Tab moves focus into the toolbar and out of it again
Left and Right arrows (Up and Down when vertical) move between items
Enter and Space activate or toggle the focused item
semantics: toggle items report aria-pressed; radio items report their checked state within their group
an icon-only item needs an aria-label

notes.text: Toolbar padding (0/4, 4/8, 4/20px), the divider's 1px cap, 12px side padding and 20px minimum height, and the vertical button's 24px icon are constants; no token gives them.

The toolbar's checked style is merged before ToggleButton's and wins at rest for every appearance, so a checked primary item loses its brand fill and shows the subtle selected grey; on hover it jumps back to its appearance's hover colours.
ToolbarDivider's vertical prop defaults to true, and its styles apply the width cap unless vertical is false: the class named vertical is the one that lifts the cap for a horizontal divider.
The Divider's minimum line length is written '8px;' with a stray semicolon, which CSS rejects; the vertical divider's two line segments have no minimum height as shipped.
The size padding applies only to a horizontal toolbar; a vertical one keeps the base 4px by 8px at every size.

The toolbar files add no forced-colour rules; items inherit Button's and ToggleButton's: a checked toggle or radio is Highlight with HighlightText text and a Highlight border, inverting on hover; a primary toggle falls back to ButtonFace with ButtonText so on and off stay distinct; focus draws the Highlight outline.

Items default to the subtle appearance and take the toolbar's size; neither is in these styles or types files. The Fluent 2 page shows subtle items, and ToolbarButton.types omits a size prop, so the size must come from the toolbar.
